Container.Name: X-ONU-SFPP-Dashboard
Container.Overview:
A lightweight monitoring dashboard for EXEN X-ONU-SFPP and compatible ONTs running 8311 community firmware.
The dashboard polls the ONT metrics endpoint and provides live and historical monitoring of RX optical power, TX optical power, TX bias current, module voltage, optic temperature, CPU temperatures, PLOAM state, and ONT reachability.
The Unraid host must have network access to the ONT management IP.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: XGS-PON XGSPON ONU ONT 8311 EXEN X-ONU-SFPP PON fiber optical monitoring
Container.Requires: An EXEN X-ONU-SFPP or compatible ONT running 8311 community firmware with the JSON metrics endpoint enabled. The Unraid server must be able to reach the ONT management IP.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: Host port used to access the X-ONU-SFPP Dashboard.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite metrics database.

Config.Name: ONT Metrics URL
Config.Description: URL of the 8311 JSON metrics endpoint.

Config.Name: Polling Interval
Config.Description: Number of seconds between ONT metric requests.

Config.Name: Retention
Config.Description: Number of days of historical samples to retain.

Config.Name: Request Timeout
Config.Description: Timeout in seconds when requesting metrics from the ONT.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Container directory used for persistent dashboard data. Normally this should remain /data.
